a: Reject alg=none; enforce expected algorithms server-side.
Do not mix HMAC secrets and public-key verification carelessly.
XSS can steal tokens in localStorage; prefer HttpOnly cookies when possible.
Stateless JWTs are hard to revoke early; use short TTL + refresh or blocklists.
Keep payloads small; avoid sensitive PII in claims.
Allow small clock skew when validating exp/nbf.
kid selects keys; validate against a trusted JWKS only.
Access tokens authorize APIs; ID tokens prove identity to the client.
Always verify aud matches your API.
Clear client tokens and revoke refresh tokens on logout.
